name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_summary: Income support to landholding farmer families
benefit_amount: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / National Health Authority
benefit_summary: Cashless health insurance cover for poor and vulnerable families for secondary and tertiary care
benefit_amount: Up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year (cashless)

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U 2.0)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit_summary: Central assistance for pucca house construction/purchase for urban poor and middle-income households
benefit_amount: Interest subsidy / central assistance; EWS houses up to 30 sq.mt. carpet area

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit_summary: Financial assistance (maintenance allowance + fee reimbursement) for SC students studying Class 11 and above
benefit_amount: Maintenance allowance and course fee reimbursement (amount varies by course/state)

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
benefit_summary: Financial assistance for minority community students studying in Classes 1 to 10

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_summary: Credit-linked subsidy for setting up new micro-enterprises to generate self-employment
benefit_amount: Subsidy of 15%-35% of project cost (up to ₹50 lakh manufacturing / ₹20 lakh service)

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Department of Posts
benefit_summary: Small savings scheme for the welfare of a girl child, opened by parent/guardian
benefit_amount: 8.2% interest (Q2 FY2026-27); deposits ₹250 to ₹1.5 lakh/year; matures 21 years from opening

name: Atal Pension Yojana
benefit_summary: Guaranteed minimum pension scheme for unorganised sector workers
benefit_amount: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY 2.0)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefit_summary: Free LPG gas connection with first refill and stove to women from poor households
benefit_amount: Free LPG connection + free first refill + free stove + subsidy on next 12 refills

name: Stand-Up India
ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefit_summary: Bank loans for greenfield enterprises set up by SC/ST and women entrepreneurs
benefit_amount: Loan amount between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
benefit_summary: Collateral-free micro-credit for non-farm income-generating enterprises
benefit_amount: Loans up to ₹20 lakh across Shishu/Kishor/Tarun/Tarun Plus categories

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefit_summary: Cash maternity benefit for pregnant women and lactating mothers for their first living child
benefit_amount: ₹5,000 in two installments (₹3,000 after ANC registration, ₹2,000 after childbirth and immunization)

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_summary: Crop insurance scheme covering losses from natural calamities, pests and diseases
benefit_amount: Farmer premium capped at 2% (Kharif), 1.5% (Rabi), 5% (commercial/horticultural crops); balance subsidized

name: e-Shram Registration
benefit_summary: National database and Universal Account Number (UAN) card for unorganised sector workers, with accident insurance
benefit_amount: ₹2 lakh accidental insurance cover under PMSBY linked to e-Shram card

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit_summary: Collateral-free working capital loans for urban street vendors
benefit_amount: Loans of ₹10,000 (1st), ₹20,000 (2nd), ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
ministry: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education
benefit_summary: Scholarship to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to prevent dropout at Class 9
benefit_amount: ₹12,000 per year (₹1,000/month) from Class 9 to Class 12

name: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
ministry: Public Health Department, Government of Maharashtra
benefit_summary: Cashless health insurance cover for economically weaker families in Maharashtra
benefit_amount: ₹1.5 lakh per family per year (up to ₹2.5 lakh for renal transplant); ₹5 lakh for Category A-C government scheme beneficiaries

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulk Shishyavrutti Yojana (EBC Scholarship)
ministry: Higher and Technical Education Department, Government of Maharashtra
benefit_summary: Tuition fee reimbursement for economically backward general category students in professional/technical courses
benefit_amount: Full tuition fee reimbursement for eligible diploma/degree/postgraduate professional courses

name: Ramai Awas Yojana
ministry: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
benefit_summary: Housing assistance for Scheduled Caste and Neo-Buddhist families to construct permanent homes
